Container.Name: Nomad
Container.Overview: Project NOMAD, the offline knowledge and education server (Wikipedia and other Kiwix libraries, courses, maps, AI search over your library), packaged as one container. NOMAD's own stack and every app it installs run inside it, so the Docker tab shows one app and updates arrive through Check for Updates.
Container.Requires: Privileged is required: NOMAD creates a container per app, and this image gives it a private Docker daemon to do that in.

Config.Name: Web UI port
Config.Description: The only port this app publishes. Every NOMAD app is reached through it under its own path.

Config.Name: Content (large)
Config.Description: ZIM libraries, maps, courses and uploads. Tens to hundreds of GB; put it on the array.

Config.Name: App data
Config.Description: Database, settings and generated secrets. Small; put it on a fast pool.

Config.Name: Private Docker storage
Config.Description: Images and containers of NOMAD's private Docker daemon. Rebuildable and busy; fast pool, and keep it out of snapshots and backups.

Config.Name: Public URL
Config.Description: The address you open NOMAD at, e.g. https://knowledge.example.com. App links are built from it.

Config.Name: AI server
Config.Description: Optional. An OpenAI-compatible server (llama-swap, LM Studio, Ollama) for NOMAD's AI chat and search, instead of installing Ollama inside. Base URL without /v1.

Config.Name: App update window
Config.Description: When the apps NOMAD installed may update themselves (local time). NOMAD itself updates through this container.
